author: KEXP
description: Texas metal band The Sword unleash colossal riffs in our latest in-studio session. With host Tanner Ellison, the group deliver a lie performance of "Tres Brujas" and more.
title: The Sword performs "Tres Brujas" & more Live on KEXP
